citation: For service, notably in the defence of cadets and General Mona Troy of the 21st Rim Worlds Regiment, the Blue Star Irregulars recognise {COMPANY.CompanyName} and bestow the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDecoration_Mercenary_BlueStarPin],Blue Star Pin]] upon them. May we fight beside each other with courage, and face each other with honour, as all mercenaries should.
